Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 and indication label 'acute myeloid leukemia'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, EFO ID as indication_curie, indication label as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
